plugin.name: screen-tools
plugin._long: Screen crosshair guides, pixel measurement, and color picker

option.name: cancel
option._long: Cancel active measurement or color picker

option.name: freeze
option._long: Freeze guide position at current cursor location

option.name: line_color
option._long: Color used for rendering alignment guides

option.name: measure
option._long: Click to measure pixel distances on screen

option.name: measure_color
option._long: Color used for measurement rectangle outline

option.name: crosshair_measure_opacity
option._long: Opacity of crosshair lines while actively measuring (0 = hidden, 100 = fully visible)

option.name: picker
option._long: Toggle color picker mode and copy color to clipboard (requires guides active)

option.name: picker_format
option._long: Format used when copying the picked color to the clipboard

option.name: picker_loupe_radius
option._long: Capture radius around cursor (grid = 2r+1 x 2r+1 pixels)

option.name: picker_cell_size
option._long: Size of each magnified pixel cell in the loupe (pixels)
